title: Q09 · DON'T LET ME KEEP YOU

shots.camText: Opens exactly on Q08's last frame: low angle up at Oren · 35 mm · locked-off
shots.note: He holds still, the bag still held out at her face height.

shots.camText: Close-up of Helena seated · 65 mm · handheld

lines.text: HELENA: Don't let me keep you.

shots.camText: Wide from across the road, locked-off · 50 mm
shots.line: OREN: "We are going in the same direction."

lines.text: OREN: We are going in the same direction.

shots.note: Small figures by the laundrette; people and a sweeper cross between us and them.

shots.camText: Close-up of Helena seated · 65 mm · handheld
shots.line: HELENA: "Are we? I didn't say I was going."

lines.text: HELENA: Are we? I didn't say I was going.

shots.note: Her eyes go to the street; a little defiant.

shots.camText: Insert: his hands at bag height · 50 mm · handheld
shots.note: He moves the bag from his left hand into his right, out of her face.

shots.camText: Medium side-on two-shot at her shoulder height · 40 mm · locked-off
shots.line: OREN: "Would you like me to look at the benefits notice?"

lines.text: OREN: Would you like me to look at the benefits notice?

shots.note: Oren on the left standing, Helena on the right seated; the offer is of help, not the bag.

shots.camText: Close-up of Helena seated · 65 mm · handheld

lines.text: HELENA: It's already been appealed. Twice.

shots.note: Tired; a short breath out before "Twice."
